attempts.summary: Configured 802.1Q VLAN trunking over the shared physical link (node1 eth1, node2/node3 enp8s0). node1 (OpenWrt) hosts eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24) as router for both VLANs, plus firewall zones 'vlan10' and 'vlan20' (input/output ACCEPT, forward REJECT, no forwarding rule between them). node2 (Ubuntu, systemd-networkd) has vlan10 sub-interface on enp8s0 at 10.10.10.2/24; node3 has vlan20 sub-interface on enp8s0 at 10.10.20.2/24. Verified each host reaches node1 on its own VLAN, cross-VLAN pings fail naturally (no route) and are explicitly REJECTed by node1's firewall when routed. Completed mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, node3: captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime, issued native reboot (systemctl reboot / busybox reboot) backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id each time, and re-verified VLAN config, IP addresses, firewall rules, and both reachability/isolation behavior post-reboot on every node.
